fundamentals.name: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. manufactures, markets, and sells skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products worldwide. The company offers skin care products, including moisturizers, serums, cleansers, toners, eye care, body care, exfoliators, acne care and oil correctors, facial masks, and sun care products; and makeup products, such as foundations, powders, concealers and setting sprays, lipsticks, lip liners and lip glosses, mascaras, and eyeshadows and eyeliners, as well as compacts, brushes, and other makeup tools. It also provides fragrance products in various forms comprising parfum, eau de parfum, eau de toilette, eau de cologne, and body spray, as well as lotions, creams, powders, candles and soaps; and hair care products, including shampoos, conditioners, styling products, treatment, finishing sprays, and hair colour products, as well as sells ancillary products and services. The company offers its products under the La Mer, Jo Malone London, TOM FORD, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, KILIAN PARIS, BALMAIN Beauty, Estée Lauder, Clinique, M·A·C, The Ordinary, Aveda, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, Bumble and bumble, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, Smashbox, Darphin Paris, Lab Series, NIOD, Aramis, and GLAMGLOW brands. It sells its products through department stores, duty-free retailers, specialty multi retailers, online pure players, upscale perfumeries and pharmacies, and top-tier salons and spas, as well as direct-to-consumer businesses across freestanding stores, and brand websites and third-party online platforms. The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

judgment.summary: Estee Lauder shows strong gross margins and cash flow but suffers from negative profit margins, high debt, and declining earnings, despite a recent positive earnings surprise.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates; next earnings date was 2026-05-01.
positives: Free cash flow (TTM) $1.81B — strong cash generation.
Last quarter EPS beat estimate by 40.2% (0.91 vs 0.65).
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target of $95.43.
negatives: Profit margin -1.7% and Return on equity -5.9% — the company is losing money on its operations.
Earnings growth YoY -45.5% and Quarterly earnings growth -44.0% — significant decline in profitability.
Next earnings date is May 1st, which has already passed, and no new date is provided.

news.paragraph: Estee Lauder's CEO confirmed the failure of a merger with Puig, a development that saw the stock fall 3.8% on June 2nd. This news follows analyst discussions questioning the company's 'Beauty Reimagined' strategy and its ability to revive long-term growth. The failed merger adds uncertainty to the company's strategic direction, with the stock already facing headwinds.
